entry_thesis: PASS (3rd PASS of the day). No conviction-8 dated-catalyst setup exists for the closing session. Full re-scan of the Jun 29 - Jul 6 earnings calendar (Finnhub, 72 names, 20 with EPS estimates) plus FDA/AdCom and macro calendars confirms no actionable asymmetry. A stock making relentless fresh lows into a 3-trading-day-out print is discounting bad news, not mispricing it. The consensus EPS also ticked up to $0.125 earlier this week, narrowing my consensus-below-guidance edge, and the decisively negative 06-25 news flow (BNP called the China distributor ban a 'strategic misstep,' surprise outside-hire CFO David Denton from Pfizer, China reshuffle) has not been rebutted. Re-recommending NKE at conviction 8 after explicitly standing down twice today would be a calibration failure. (2) STZ (Jun 30 AMC) — RBC stated TODAY they expect 'in-line' results and 'reiterate outlook'; the market is pricing the base case = priced-in (no asymmetry, conviction ~4). (3) AVAV (Jun 29 AMC) — THREE price-target cuts on 06-26 (BTIG -$125, KeyBanc to $220, Piper to $248); negative estimate revisions signal analysts see downside risk into the print; today's +1.6% bounce is contradictory and offers no clean bullish edge (conviction ~4). (4) CNXC (Jun 29 AMC) — +9.6% today on no news; a 10% pre-earnings pop is the definition of a priced-in trap (upside eaten). (5) FDS (Jul 1 BMO) — +10.5% today; same priced-in-trap rejection. (6) GBX (Jul 1 AMC) — flat; railcar cyclical, no identified EPS-reaction asymmetry. (7) FDA calendar: AdCom endpoint unavailable; prior scans confirm NO PDUFA/AdCom drug-approval binary in Jun 26 - Jul 10 (next is Jul 23 Pharmacy Compounding — not tradeable). (8) Macro: economic calendar empty for next 7 days (no CPI/NFP/FOMC; next material prints late-July). With scorecard at 21.6% win rate / -4.09% avg return and conviction-8 the hard execution threshold, forcing a sub-8 call would violate my restriction. Discipline says wait for a cleaner, higher-asymmetry setup.
